'''TA-350''' was the designation of a [[Probe droid/Legends|probe droid]] of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] deployed to [[Belsavis/Legends|Belsavis]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. Stationed in [[The Tomb]], the droid tasked an Imperial spacer to recover Rakata stasis technology from one of the vaults. When the spacer returned the samples, TA-350 uploaded them to Commander [[Calum]] on [[Proculus Station]].<ref name="TOR" />

TA-350 was guarded during his deployment by [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droid]] [[K0-29]].<ref name="TOR" />
